vt1025010.title: Fujifilm FinePix X10 12MP Compact Digital Camera Black with Box and Accessories
vt1025010.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1025010.details: Fujifilm FinePix X10 premium compact digital camera in black, with a 12 megapixel 2/3-inch EXR CMOS sensor, a FUJINON 4x optical zoom lens (28-112 mm equivalent, f/2.0-2.8), a 2.8 inch LCD, an optical viewfinder, RAW shooting and Full HD video. It uses an NP-50 battery. Condition: clean overall with no noticeable scratches or dirt on the body, as shown in the photos. Optics: no fungus or haze that affects shooting, but two small spots of mold were found inside the lens; they do not affect the pictures. Checked and working: the zoom, the flash, the buttons and dials, the LCD display, sound, and battery charging and start-up. Included, as shown in the photos: the camera, the original box, the battery, the charger, the power cable, the strap, the lens cap, the manual and the CD-ROM. No SD card is included.
vt1025010.why: A used Fujifilm FinePix X10 compact digital camera with box.
vt1025010.perfect: Compact camera fans who want a classic-style premium compact with a viewfinder and a bright zoom lens.
vt1025010.exp: A pre-owned Fujifilm FinePix X10 compact digital camera with box in the condition described above.
vt1025010.cd: Pre-owned, clean overall with no noticeable scratches or dirt on the body. Two small spots of mold were found inside the lens; they do not affect the pictures. Zoom, flash, buttons and dials, LCD, sound, and battery charging and start-up were checked and work. The box and the original accessories are included; no SD card. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
